itineraries.summary: 10-day Egypt route flying in and out of Cairo, balancing history, culture, adventure, and relaxation. Days 1-2: Cairo & Giza (pyramids, Sphinx, Saqqara, Nile dinner). Days 3-4: fly to Aswan (Philae Temple, Nubian village) then board a Nile cruise with Kom Ombo at sunset. Days 5-6: Luxor (Edfu/Karnak/Luxor temples, sunrise hot air balloon, Valley of the Kings, Nile-front resort). Days 7-9: Hurghada Red Sea beach/snorkel days. Day 10: fly back to Cairo for the GEM, Khan El Khalili, then fly home. Caption credits the route as '[planned by The World Within Us Travels]' - her promotion/repost of that agency's itinerary.
itineraries.title: 10 Days in Egypt: Cairo, Nile Cruise & the Red Sea

itineraries.summary: Budget-Maldives guide from his TikTok caption: skip the ultra-luxurious resorts and stay in guesthouses on inhabited islands or city hotels in the urban centers. Many guesthouses run all-inclusive rates covering meals plus diving/snorkeling excursions, so under $150/day per atoll gets you snorkeling with manta rays, whale sharks, nurse sharks, and visits like the Keyodhoo shipwreck. 'Can you stay in the Maldives on a budget? The answer is yes definitely.'
itineraries.title: Maldives on a Budget: Local-Island Stays
